name: myio-mcp
description: MCP server for the myIO smart home controller: outputs, thermostats, shutters, RGB, sensors, timers, scenes, users, Flow rules, scripts, diagnostics, logs, files, Shelly, MQTT, Cloud, alarm, MIA, network, KNX, DALI, DMX, Modbus - with read-back, several controllers, resources (live state, logs, docs) and prompts (heating overview, why does X not switch, daily diagnostics, new Flow rule)

MYIO_BASE_URL.title: myIO Server URL
MYIO_BASE_URL.description: The full URL of your myIO controller (e.g. http://192.168.1.178)

MYIO_USERNAME.title: Username
MYIO_USERNAME.description: Basic auth username for your myIO controller

MYIO_PASSWORD.title: Password
MYIO_PASSWORD.description: Basic auth password for your myIO server

MYIO_NAME.title: Controller label
MYIO_NAME.description: Short name shown in replies (e.g. Ground floor)

MYIO_SERVERS.title: Several controllers (optional)
MYIO_SERVERS.description: JSON list to use more than one controller, e.g. [{"name":"Ground floor","url":"http://192.168.1.178","username":"admin","password":"..."},{"name":"Upstairs","url":"http://192.168.1.177",...}] - overrides the single URL above

MYIO_WRITE.title: Write level
MYIO_WRITE.description: What the AI may change: state (switch outputs, thermostat targets, run Flow rules / scripts, SG mode, LED events), config (also names, timers, scenes, structures, Flow rules, scripts, files, integration and expander settings), admin (also users, permissions, system files, network, Cloud keys, restart / OTA, KNX/DALI addressing)

MYIO_TOOLSETS.title: Tool groups
MYIO_TOOLSETS.description: Which tool groups to load (fewer = less context used): core (always), legacy, house, config, automation, diag, integrations, expanders. "all" (default), a comma list like "house,automation", or "all,-legacy,-expanders".
